stories.title: EU fija para diciembre ejecución del exmayor, Nidal Hasan; será primera ejecución militar desde 1961

en.title: EU sets December execution date for former Major Nidal Hasan; first military execution since 1961
en.summary: Former Major Nidal Hasan is scheduled for execution in December, marking the first military execution in the United States since 1961. Hasan opened fire on soldiers at a deployment preparation center on November 5, 2009.

stories.title: Diputados avalan cambios a la Ley Aduanera contra la subvaluación de mercancías

en.title: Deputies approve changes to the Customs Law against merchandise undervaluation
en.summary: Mexico's Chamber of Deputies passed modifications to the Customs Law with 334 votes in favor and 119 against, addressing undervaluation of goods in customs procedures.

stories.title: Diputados avalan en lo general reforma a la Ley Aduanera; buscan endurecer penas contra el huachicol fiscal

en.title: Deputies approve in general reform to the Customs Law; seek to strengthen penalties against fiscal fuel theft
en.summary: Mexico's Chamber of Deputies approved a general reform to the Customs Law aimed at increasing penalties related to illegal fuel trafficking and tax evasion.

stories.title: Avalan reforma a Ley Aduanera en Cámara de Diputados

en.title: Customs Law reform approved in Chamber of Deputies
en.summary: The Chamber of Deputies passed a Customs Law reform that expands inspection capabilities for merchandise valuation and establishes precautionary seizure grounds.

stories.title: Las emotivas palabras de Lionel Messi en su despedida de la Selección Argentina: "No quiero dejar la cancha"

en.title: Lionel Messi's emotional words in his farewell to the Argentine national team: "I don't want to leave the pitch"
en.summary: The Argentine star said goodbye by scoring a goal and providing two assists in his final international match.

stories.title: Acciones de Paramount bajan tras fusionarse con Warner Bros

en.title: Paramount shares fall after merging with Warner Bros
en.summary: Paramount's stock declined following the company's acquisition by Warner Bros Discovery in a deal valued at 110 billion dollars.

stories.title: Lionel Messi se despide de la selección argentina con gol, doble asistencia, lágrimas y una goleada ante Benín

en.title: Lionel Messi says goodbye to the Argentine national team with a goal, double assist, tears and a rout against Benin
en.summary: Messi concluded over two decades of international career by leading Argentina to a 3-0 victory over Benin before more than 80,000 spectators at the Monumental.

stories.title: Diputados inician discusión en el pleno de la reforma a Ley Aduanera

en.title: Deputies begin discussion in plenary of the reform to the Customs Law
en.summary: Lawmakers are debating customs legislation reforms, including provisions allowing customs authorities to seize goods when undervaluation is below 50 percent.

stories.title: Así cambia Hollywood tras la compra de Warner Bros. por Paramount; ¿quién controla qué?

en.title: How Hollywood changes after Paramount's purchase of Warner Bros.; who controls what?
en.summary: Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. reshapes the entertainment industry landscape. The combined entity controls major franchises including Mission Impossible and Harry Potter.

stories.title: Diputados avalan declaratoria de reforma sobre nacionalidad única para Presidencia; turnan al Ejecutivo

en.title: Deputies approve declaration of reform on single nationality for Presidency; send to Executive
en.summary: Mexican deputies have approved a constitutional reform declaration requiring single nationality for the presidency. The measure received 22 approvals from state congresses before being forwarded to the executive branch.

stories.title: Iván Cazarín, regional CJNG boss known as ‘El Tanque,’ is captured in Zapopan

en.title: Iván Cazarín, regional CJNG boss known as 'El Tanque,' is captured in Zapopan
en.summary: Authorities captured Iván Cazarín, a major regional leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel. He directed fuel theft operations across multiple Mexican states and faces charges including homicide, kidnapping, money laundering and drug trafficking.

stories.title: Cae 'El Tanque', líder regional del CJNG y cercano al Mencho

en.title: El Tanque, regional leader of CJNG and close to Mencho, arrested
en.summary: Authorities announced the capture of El Tanque, a regional CJNG leader operating in Veracruz, Oaxaca, Tabasco and Puebla with ties to El Mencho.

stories.title: El registro telefónico supera los 90 millones de líneas vinculadas

en.title: Telephone registry exceeds 90 million linked lines
en.summary: Mexico's telephone registry has surpassed 90 million registered lines following the deadline for phone numbers ending in 3.

stories.title: México cierra la puerta a inversiones de riesgo, pero el nuevo filtro de 49% deja rendijas

en.title: Mexico closes the door to risky investments, but the new 49% filter leaves openings
en.summary: Mexico implements new restrictions on foreign investment in strategic sectors, though a 49% ownership threshold creates potential loopholes. New projects and minority stakes with influence over strategic areas may require national security review.

stories.title: Prime Day 2026: las mejores ofertas y promociones bancarias para ahorrar durante el evento de Amazon

en.title: Prime Day 2026: the best banking offers and promotions to save during Amazon's event
en.summary: Credit cards, coupons, interest-free periods, and discounts on technology, home goods, and fashion are available during Prime Day to help consumers reduce their overall spending.

stories.title: Sin reforma fiscal, el SAT aumentó 776,000 millones la recaudación de impuestos, dice Hacienda

en.title: Without fiscal reform, the SAT increased tax collection by 776,000 million, says Hacienda
en.summary: Mexico's tax authority increased revenue collection significantly, with government officials indicating that pending digital economy and cadastral laws will contribute to future income growth.
